items.name: Anthropic (ANT)

note.de: 825 Mio. Aktien zu 70–78 USD; laut Bloomberg (via Handelsblatt, 17.11.) Preis am oberen Ende oder darüber, Orderbuch am 17.11. geschlossen; Preisfestsetzung Mittwochabend New Yorker Zeit, Handelsstart Donnerstag, 19.11.
note.bg: 825 млн. акции по 70–78 USD; според Bloomberg (чрез Handelsblatt, 17.11.) цената ще е в горния край или над него, книгата на поръчките е затворена на 17.11.; цената се определя в сряда вечерта нюйоркско време, търговията започва в четвъртък, 19.11.
note.en: 825m shares at USD 70–78; Bloomberg (via Handelsblatt, 17 Nov) says pricing at the top of the range or above, order book closed on 17 Nov; pricing on Wednesday evening New York time, trading from Thursday, 19 Nov.
note.es: 825 millones de acciones a 70–78 USD; según Bloomberg (vía Handelsblatt, 17/11), precio en la parte alta del rango o por encima, libro cerrado el 17/11; precio el miércoles por la noche (hora de Nueva York), cotización desde el jueves 19/11.
note.tr: 70–78 USD'den 825 milyon hisse; Bloomberg'e göre (Handelsblatt aracılığıyla, 17.11) fiyat aralığın üst ucunda veya üzerinde, talep defteri 17.11'de kapandı; fiyat Çarşamba akşamı New York saatiyle belirlenecek, işlemler 19.11 Perşembe başlıyor.

items.name: METKA (Metlen)

note.de: Zeichnung 18.–20.11. zu 10,00–11,50 Euro je Aktie; bis zu 25 Mio. neue und 5 Mio. alte Aktien (plus Option auf 5 Mio.), Ziel rund 250 Mio. Euro für das Unternehmen, Preis am 20.11., erster Handelstag 26.11.
note.bg: Записване 18–20.11. по 10,00–11,50 евро за акция; до 25 млн. нови и 5 млн. съществуващи акции (плюс опция за още 5 млн.), цел около 250 млн. евро за компанията, цена на 20.11., първи ден на търговия 26.11.
note.en: Subscription 18–20 Nov at EUR 10.00–11.50 per share; up to 25m new and 5m existing shares (plus an option for 5m more), targeting about EUR 250m for the company, pricing on 20 Nov, first trading day 26 Nov.
note.es: Suscripción del 18 al 20/11 a 10,00–11,50 euros por acción; hasta 25 millones de acciones nuevas y 5 millones existentes (más opción de otros 5 millones), objetivo de unos 250 millones para la empresa, precio el 20/11, cotización el 26/11.
note.tr: Talep toplama 18–20.11, hisse başına 10,00–11,50 euro; 25 milyona kadar yeni ve 5 milyon mevcut hisse (artı 5 milyonluk opsiyon), şirket için yaklaşık 250 milyon euro hedefi, fiyat 20.11'de, ilk işlem günü 26.11.

items.name: Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL)

note.de: Coal India verkauft 10 % der Tochter (661,8 Mio. Altaktien) zu 129–136 Rupien, rund 89,8 Mrd. Rupien; Großanleger am 18.11., Zeichnung 19.–23.11., Notierung voraussichtlich am 27.11.
note.bg: Coal India продава 10% от дъщерното дружество (661,8 млн. съществуващи акции) по 129–136 рупии, около 89,8 млрд. рупии; големи инвеститори на 18.11., записване 19–23.11., листване се очаква на 27.11.
note.en: Coal India sells 10% of the unit (661.8m existing shares) at INR 129–136, about INR 89.8bn; anchor investors on 18 Nov, subscription 19–23 Nov, listing expected on 27 Nov.
note.es: Coal India vende el 10 % de la filial (661,8 millones de acciones existentes) a 129–136 rupias, unos 89.800 millones de rupias; inversores ancla el 18/11, suscripción del 19 al 23/11, cotización prevista el 27/11.
note.tr: Coal India iştirakinin %10'unu (661,8 milyon mevcut hisse) 129–136 rupiden satıyor, yaklaşık 89,8 milyar rupi; çapa yatırımcılar 18.11'de, talep toplama 19–23.11, işlem başlangıcı 27.11'de bekleniyor.

items.name: Japan Home Shield (667A)

sector.bg: Геотехнически проучвания и проверка на сгради
sector.es: Estudios geotécnicos e inspección de edificios

note.de: Reiner Verkauf von 4,17 Mio. Altaktien (plus 0,63 Mio. Mehrzuteilung) bei vorläufig 1.220–1.240 JPY; Ausgabepreis wird am 18.11. festgelegt, Zeichnung 19.–25.11., Konsortialführer Nomura.
note.bg: Продават се само 4,17 млн. съществуващи акции (плюс 0,63 млн. допълнително разпределение) при ориентировъчно 1220–1240 JPY; цената се определя на 18.11., записване 19–25.11., водеща банка Nomura.
note.en: Secondary sale only of 4.17m existing shares (plus 0.63m over-allotment) at an indicative JPY 1,220–1,240; offer price set on 18 Nov, subscription 19–25 Nov, lead manager Nomura.
note.es: Solo venta de 4,17 millones de acciones existentes (más 0,63 millones de sobreasignación) a 1.220–1.240 JPY indicativos; precio el 18/11, suscripción del 19 al 25/11, coordinador Nomura.
note.tr: Yalnızca 4,17 milyon mevcut hissenin satışı (artı 0,63 milyon ek tahsis), gösterge fiyat 1.220–1.240 JPY; fiyat 18.11'de belirleniyor, talep 19–25.11, lider aracı Nomura.

items.name: American Barrick Gold (ABGC)

note.de: Abspaltung der Nordamerika-Minen von Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); Börsenprospekt am 10.11. eingereicht, Preis und Aktienzahl offen, Renaissance Capital schätzt bis zu 6 Mrd. USD; Start laut Barrick bis Anfang 2027.
note.bg: Отделяне на северноамериканските мини на Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); проспектът е подаден на 10.11., цена и брой акции още няма, Renaissance Capital оценява до 6 млрд. USD; старт според Barrick до началото на 2027 г.
note.en: Carve-out of Barrick Mining's North American mines (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); filed on 10 Nov with price and share count still open, Renaissance Capital estimates up to USD 6bn; launch by early 2027 according to Barrick.
note.es: Escisión de las minas norteamericanas de Barrick Mining (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); folleto presentado el 10/11, sin precio ni número de acciones, Renaissance Capital estima hasta 6.000 millones de USD; lanzamiento a principios de 2027 según Barrick.
note.tr: Barrick Mining'in Kuzey Amerika madenlerinin ayrılması (Nevada Gold Mines, Pueblo Viejo); izahname 10.11'de sunuldu, fiyat ve hisse sayısı belli değil, Renaissance Capital 6 milyar USD'ye kadar tahmin ediyor; Barrick'e göre başlangıç 2027 başına kadar.

items.src_n: Renaissance Capital – American Barrick Gold files for an estimated $6 billion IPO (10.11.2026); The Deep Dive (11.11.2026: Start bis Anfang 2027 laut CEO Mark Hill)

items.name: Windward Bio (WWB)

sector.es: Biotecnología (enfermedades respiratorias y de la piel)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 17 USD, die Mitte der Spanne von 16–18 USD; laut Renaissance Capital schloss die Aktie den ersten Handelstag 67,6 % über dem Ausgabepreis.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 17 USD – средата на диапазона 16–18 USD; според Renaissance Capital акцията завърши първия ден с 67,6% над цената на предлагането.
note.en: Priced at USD 17, the midpoint of the USD 16–18 range; according to Renaissance Capital the stock ended its first day 67.6% above the offer price.
note.es: Precio de salida de 17 USD, el punto medio del rango de 16–18 USD; según Renaissance Capital, cerró su primer día un 67,6 % por encima del precio de salida.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı 16–18 USD aralığının ortası olan 17 USD; Renaissance Capital'e göre hisse ilk günü halka arz fiyatının %67,6 üzerinde kapattı.
